_README: Expected-destination manifest for TGE (Round 6 / D2 fix). Copy to addresses.<network>.json (e.g. addresses.ethereum.json), fill EVERY field with the FINAL, TRIPLE-CHECKED checksummed address, and commit it to a SEPARATE secure record before TGE. scripts/verify/verify_tge_targets.js diffs the live .env/00_config values against this file and ABORTS 06_execute_tge.js on ANY mismatch. This is the last line of defence against a mis-set env var sending billions of SRX to a wrong, irreversible address. addresses.<network>.json is gitignored — keep the authoritative copy in your deployment runbook / Safe records.

tgeAllocations._note: Destinations MUST match 06_execute_tge.js finalAllocations exactly. Vaults are deployed contracts; liquidity/staking/treasury/strategic are the contracts or Safe wallets that receive direct allocations.

_invariant: Sum of amountSRX MUST equal 10000000000 (MAX_SUPPLY). verify_tge_targets.js asserts this.
